text: yeah ok i see them also kinda cool u can do that into an artifact so easily now they finally make the harness not a piece of shit lmao anyways so uh yeah so clearly 256 looks the best. but also, a sticker, from my PoV, will be like a 4x6 thermal label size, which like you can fit a whole lot of those on a wall. or am i misunderstanding it and maybe that doesnt matter at all.
resolution: Answered the 4x6-label question: it matters and it forks the design. A 10x15cm sticker baked into the wall atlas gets only 26x39 texels even at the user's chosen 256 px/m ambient density (which is now LOCKED for graffiti/freehand per his artifact verdict), so stickers must NOT be resampled into the surface — they render as their own decal quads sampling their own authored-resolution texture (e.g. 812x1218 = 203dpi thermal-label), staying crisp at any placement scale, exactly like real printed stickers. Mechanism already exists: pieceSkins skin-box quads with a pixel texture instead of WGSL; storage stays stroke-program + placement rows per the paint ruling. Two-tier density contract recorded: ambient 256 px/m facade canvas for paint, per-sticker authored density for stamps.
